description: This file defines the Comment controller class for the CMS module in an OpenCart project. It handles displaying, listing, replying, adding, and rating comments associated with articles, including security features like tokens and captcha integration.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing article comments in the CMS module of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main comment view for an article, including sorting, captcha, and login status.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of comments via the getList controller.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of comments for an article, including reply links and ratings.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Outputs replies to a specific comment.

methods.name: getReplies
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of replies for a specific comment.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a new comment or reply, including validation, captcha, and spam checks.
